findings.label: Feed retry margin after an API timeout
findings.summary: After an 8 s API timeout the third feed attempt runs only if the first two feed attempts fail within 2 s combined (10 s today). Documented D3 trade-off; realistic API failures (400/403) return in well under a second.
findings.action: No change now. Lower API_TIMEOUT_MS if runner rows ever show 'api: timeout' together with 'HTTP 404 (2 attempts)'.

findings.label: Host-scoped redaction vs off-domain redirect
findings.summary: once() follows up to five redirects to any host and redactKey only matches googleapis.com, so a 3xx off-domain that preserved the query string would put the key into HttpError.url/message. Google does not redirect this endpoint; no known trigger.
findings.action: Optional hardening: redact or refuse off-host redirect targets when the original request host is googleapis.com.

findings.label: Pipeline-level timeout case not pinned
findings.summary: The fallback matrix covers HTTP, network and parse failures but not TimeoutError; 'api: timeout, fell back to feed' is not asserted end to end.
findings.action: Add a { throw: new TimeoutError(API) } override to the matrix in tests/youtube.test.js.
